one_line: AI giants raise billions, compute expands worldwide, and safety and legal battles intensify.

themes.title: AI firms secure record funding
themes.text: DeepSeek raised roughly $15 billion in a funding round. OpenAI is negotiating a private raise of up to $30 billion, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: Global AI compute capacity surges
themes.text: SpaceX aims for 13 GW of AI compute capacity by end‑2027. Kazakhstan’s Firebird is constructing a data center with 45,000 Grace GPUs, targeting roughly 500 MW of AI capacity.

stories.headline: SpaceX aims for 13 GW AI compute capacity by end of 2027
Kazakhstan expands AI compute with 45,000 Grace GPUs and new data centers

themes.title: AI safety incidents prompt restrictions
themes.text: Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access thousands of Microsoft 365 tenants. Major U.S. banks are blocking third‑party AI agents from customer accounts after detecting unauthorized activity.

stories.headline: Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
Major US banks block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts

themes.title: Legal battles over AI training data
themes.text: Anthropic argued that using copyrighted song lyrics to train Claude is fair use, while Meta’s new commercial terms permit scraping news sites for AI training.

stories.headline: Anthropic argues fair use for song lyrics in Claude training as US judge hears case
Meta’s new commercial terms could let it scrape news sites for AI training
